# Use the current docs note form without turning a typo follow-up into a rule

The original architecture chapter used emphasis for its migration aside, while the accepted relocated folder_storage.md uses a MyST note directive with a linked migration bug. For nearby documentation, prefer a semantic note for a true aside and preserve its source link. The human spelling/whitespace follow-up remains in coverage, but it does not establish a new code-style or formatter rule. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Folder documentation markup.
